Puntea 8→9

Which village schools send the most children into grade 9 already failing. Built from Evaluarea Națională results and smoothed, so a 12-pupil school doesn't read as noise. The line that matters is the 5.

Don't tell them what to do. Give them a taste for the sea — and make sure there's room in the boat. North star, after Saint-Exupéry, Citadelle (1948). Positioning: we're not a new NGO — we're the infrastructure for programmes that already run.

Școala dumneavoastră

Tastați numele școlii, al satului sau al comunei. Datele de mai jos sunt publice — Evaluarea Națională 2023–2026, bugetele locale și listele de programe ale ministerului.

    Match schools to your programme

    Pick your organisation, then drag the blue pin — or click anywhere on the map — to set where you work from. Slide between "close to us" and "most in need" and the shortlist re-ranks. Schools that already run a PNRAS project or a meal programme are skipped unless you untick it.

    Programmes on the map

    Education NGOs working with rural or at-risk pupils, with the counties where their public pages say they operate. Curated September 2026 from their own sites and press releases. Teach for Romania (30 counties) and Junior Achievement (national) list only the counties we could confirm, so absence here is not proof of absence.

    How the smoothing works

    Each school's share of candidates below 5 is pulled toward the average of similar schools in its county (rural with rural). A 12-pupil school moves a lot; a 150-pupil school barely moves. Years are pooled. Method: empirical-Bayes beta-binomial, fitted per county × setting.

    The blind spot

    These results only see pupils who sat the exam. Of 162,616 pupils enrolled in grade 8, about 14,600 (8.8%) never registered for EN 2026 — and the 2025 gap was about the same (16,815, ~9%), so this recurs every June rather than being a 2026 deterioration. It mixes repetenți, transfers and administrative loss, not pure dropout. Pair with INS TEMPO SCL103D (pupils by locality) to estimate who vanished before the exam.
